references.use: Per-action expansion: the hovered or focused action shows its label; timing and icon-first anatomy.
Track anatomy: one rounded track with 4px padding, 32px items, a shared hover highlight.

adaptations: No upstream code copied: the row enhances buttons a non-React page already owns instead of rendering its own items.
Label expansion is CSS (max-width and opacity) so page-owned buttons need no animation library.
Colours read the page's surface, line and text custom properties.
